source_text: Aaron ad Moysen: ne imponas in nos peccatum. Maria sicut aborsus — formata in vulva synagogae, ad perfectum partum non pervenit. Spuens in faciem erubescere septem diebus; Maria signum repudiationis gerit.
pass_a_gloss: Aaron to Moses: do-not lay upon us sin. Miriam as miscarriage — formed in womb of-synagogue, to perfect birth not arrived. Spitting into face to-blush seven days; Miriam sign of-repudiation bears.
pass_b_english: Aaron pleads, [[Do not lay this sin upon us >> Bible:Numbers 12:11-12]]. Miriam is like a miscarriage — formed in the synagogue’s womb, never brought to perfect birth. [[If her father had spit in her face, would she not be ashamed seven days? >> Bible:Numbers 12:14]] Miriam bears a sign of repudiation.
